chapters.title: Bengal Mango Valley
chapters.regionalInspiration: Sun-drenched Rajshahi (Bangladesh) and Malda (India) summer Himsagar mango orchards, red-clay garden paths, woven bamboo fruit baskets, and terracotta orchard walls.

visualTheme.architecture: Terracotta brick garden arches, split-bamboo scaffolding, golden mango-leaf canopies
visualTheme.ambientProps: Woven tukri mango baskets, brass orchard bells, fluttering yellow orioles, wooden ox-cart wheels

chapters.title: Sylhet Tea Garden
chapters.regionalInspiration: Lush rolling emerald tea estates of Sreemangal/Sylhet (Bangladesh) and Assam (India), bamboo irrigation flumes, wooden waterwheels, and cool morning valley mist.

visualTheme.architecture: Tiered hillside stone retaining walls, timber watermills, suspended rope footbridges
visualTheme.ambientProps: Plucking baskets, steaming porcelain teacups, drifting valley mist ribbons, wooden shade trees

chapters.title: Sundarbans Adventure
chapters.regionalInspiration: World's largest coastal mangrove forest spanning Bangladesh and West Bengal—winding tidal creeks, aerial pneumatophore roots, wild golden honeycombs, and wooden dinghy boats.

visualTheme.architecture: Elevated timber boardwalks, mangrove root arches, watchtower stilts, brass honey-collector lanterns
visualTheme.ambientProps: Spotted deer silhouettes in distant reeds, kingfishers, dripping golden honeycombs, bubbling silt pools

chapters.title: Litchi Orchard Escape
chapters.regionalInspiration: Vibrant crimson summer litchi groves of Dinajpur (Bangladesh) and Muzaffarpur (India), high treehouse platforms, pulley zip-lines, and sunlit orchard canopies.

visualTheme.architecture: Treehouse timber decks, pulley zip-tracks, woven reed windbreaks, brass orchard scales
visualTheme.ambientProps: Bunches of ruby litchis hanging overhead, kite tails in branches, wooden sorting crates

chapters.title: Riverside Candy Market
chapters.regionalInspiration: Lively secular riverfront sweet & fruit bazaars along the Padma, Buriganga, and Hooghly rivers—striped canvas awnings, sizzling jilapi skillets, brass sweet-trays, and wooden ferries.

visualTheme.architecture: Pier boardwalks, colourful striped bazaar stalls, brass scales, wrought-iron archway lanterns
visualTheme.ambientProps: Stacks of clay rasgulla pots (handi), sizzling jilapi coils, painted rickshaw-art geometric borders

chapters.title: Tropical Island Survival
chapters.regionalInspiration: Turquoise coral lagoons and coconut palms of St. Martin's Island (Bangladesh) and the Andaman/Lakshadweep islands (India).

visualTheme.architecture: Coral-stone tide walls, driftwood bridges, bamboo beach cabanas, shell-mirror bumpers
visualTheme.ambientProps: Swaying coconut palms, starfish on white sand, turquoise tide pools, striped beach umbrellas

chapters.title: Monsoon River Rescue
chapters.regionalInspiration: Dramatic Meghna & Brahmaputra monsoon river crossings—silver rain curtains, paper boats, brass sluice floodgates, and surging turquoise currents.

visualTheme.architecture: Brick river embankments, bronze sluice gates, covered country sampans, floating bamboo docks
visualTheme.ambientProps: Origami paper boats, blooming pink water-lilies (shapla), rain ripples, glowing mason-jar fireflies

chapters.title: Himalayan Foothill Expedition
chapters.regionalInspiration: Crisp alpine pine valleys, Darjeeling/Dooars mountain toy-train stone viaducts, sunlit snow ledges, and mandarin foothill terraces.

visualTheme.architecture: Arched mountain stone viaducts, timber cable-car stations, frosted pine trestles
visualTheme.ambientProps: Miniature blue steam-train tracks, pinecones, icicle chimes, steaming kulfi & chai thermoses

chapters.title: Colorful Fruit Festival
chapters.regionalInspiration: Secular rural harvest & orchard craft fair (Mela)—handcrafted paper pinwheels, colourful kites, wooden ferris wheels, folk geometric alpona floor borders, and overflowing fruit pavilions.

visualTheme.architecture: Painted bamboo festival pavilions, spinning wooden fairground wheels, ribbon-draped bridges
visualTheme.ambientProps: Diamond paper kites (ghuri), spinning colour pinwheels, clay sweet platters, confetti streamers

chapters.title: Crystal Jungle Adventure
chapters.regionalInspiration: Luminous subterranean quartz-and-waterfall caverns beneath the lush Bandarban/Meghalaya green hills—natural living-root bridges, glowing mineral geodes, and emerald underground rivers.

visualTheme.architecture: Living-root suspension spans, giant natural amethyst/quartz geodes, cascading subterranean waterfalls
visualTheme.ambientProps: Refracting rainbow light shafts, bioluminescent ferns, crystal chimes, golden rescue sanctuary
